title: Gyakusatsu Kigen Manga Gets Animated Promotional Video
content:
The official YouTube channel for Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine began streaming an animated promotional video on Wednesday to celebrate the debut of the first compiled book volume for Shiwasu Hoshikawa and Yūichirō Momose 's new manga Gyakusatsu Kigen (Genocide Origin). The volume shipped on Thursday. Sōma Saitō narrates the video.

Takehiro Kubota ( My Happy Marriage ) storyboarded the video, with Atsushi Ikariya and Keita Shimizu as key animators. Masakazu Miyake and Taichi Maezuka drew the backgrounds. Tetsuya Tatamitani was the editor and the compositing director of photography. Yashikin composed the music. Ippei Tomari is credited for sound effects and casting.

The manga is set in a Japan that is wracked with everyday news of brutal crimes. The high schooler protagonist Rakki is rescued from a fight with a classmate by a delinquent known as "A." Then vicious murderers known simply as "K" and "D" appear before them, and Rakki learns of the murder of his classmates.

Hoshikawa and Momose launched the manga in Afternoon on May 25.

Hoshikawa launched the Bungo Stray Dogs STORM BRINGER manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in January 2025. The manga is an adaptation of the eighth light novel of the same title in Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa 's Bungo Stray Dogs light novel series. Kadokawa shipped the first compiled book volume in September 2025.

Hoshikawa's Bungo Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Age Fifteen manga ended with its fourth and final compiled book volume, which shipped in October 2024. Hoshikawa launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Shōnen Ace magazine in September 2022. The manga is based on the seventh light novel volume of the same title that shipped in August 2019, and explores the past of the characters Osamu Dazai and Chuuya Nakahara. Yen Press publishes the manga in English.

Momose launched the Datewars project in August 2025, with Hanaharu Naruko ( Kamichu! , Gargantia on the Verdurous Planet , Kandagawa Jet Girls ) as character designer, and Mino as music producer, video creator, and music commentator. The "timeless music IP project" aims to bring new life to musical styles from the 70s to the 2000s, and involves 14 voice actresses, with plans for the franchise to expand into manga, anime, mobile games, concerts, films, and stage events.

Momose is the main scenario writer for Hypnosis Mic . King Records ' rap-themed project features voice actors who rap in the personas of original characters, and it launched in September 2017. Hypnosis Mic 's first full album Enter the Hypnosis Microphone launched in April 2018. The group earned the top spot as the most popular voice actor Twitter account in Japan for 2018.
author: ANN

title: Bless TV Anime Casts Tarusuke Shingaki; Crunchyroll to Stream Series
content:
The staff for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Tarusuke Shingaki will voice Hikaru Oya in the series. In addition, Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will stream the series worldwide excluding Japan and China when it debuts in January.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

• Yoshino Aoyama as Oroka Sumeragi

• Momoka Terasawa as Shitataka Sumeragi

• Kentarō Kumagai as MM

• Yoshiki Nakajima as Joe Osaki

• Kōki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha published the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: 'Psyren' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced a pair of additional cast on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV.

Voice actors Reiko Suzuki ( Versailles no Bara ) and Ayumu Murase ( Chainsaw Man ) are joining the cast as Elmore Tenjuin and Van Tenjuin, respectively.

Katsumi Ono ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) is directing the anime at Satelight , with Shin Yoshida ( Sacred Seven ) handling the series composition. Shiro Ookuma ( Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume o Minai animation director) is designing the characters. Takashi Oomama ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( Ore wa Subete wo "Parry" suru ), and Shuu Kanematsu ( Hametsu no Oukoku ) are composing the music.

Iwashiro drew the sci-fi action manga in Weekly Shounen Jump from December 2007 to November 2010. Shueisha published the 16th and final volume in March 2011.

SOW penned a side story light novel with illustrations by Iwashiro under Shueisha's Jump J Books imprint from September 2010 to March 2011.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in April 2010 and published the 16th and final volume in May 2014.

title: Crunchyroll Reveals English Dub Cast, Staff Members, for The World's Strongest Witch Anime
content:
Crunchyroll revealed the English dub cast and staff members for the anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita : Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu ) light novel series on Wednesday. The first English dub episode also streamed on Wednesday.

The English dub cast members for the first episode are:

• Lindsay Seidel as Lorna

• Blake McNamara as Rowser

• Randy Pearlman as Brau

• Mikaela Krantz as Yggdrasil

• Trey Upton as Lord of the Woods

• Maganda Marie as Lorna's mom

Additional voices include Conner Allison , Tom Aglio , Greg Dulcie , Jonathan Lim , Jordan Kendrick , Zach Zeidman , Dusty Feeney , and Cheyenne Haynes .

The English dub staff members are:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Zach Bolton

• Adaptation Supervisor: Macy Anne Johnson

• Adaptation: Domonique French

• Adaptation Prep: Stevie Rae Krieger

• Voice Director: Manuel Angel Aragón

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Paola Guzman

• Mixer: James Baker

Yen Press is releasing the light novels in English and describes the story:

When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means…

The anime premiered in Japan on October 7. Crunchyroll streams the anime as it airs.

Jōji Furuta ( ēlDLIVE , Double Decker! Doug & Kirill , Bad Girl ) is directing the anime at the studios Bridge and Aisle . Shoji Yonemura ( Pokémon Journeys: The Series , One Piece 2013-onwards, Bad Girl ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yūki Morimoto ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ , Boarding School Juliet , Bad Girl ) is designing the characters.

HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily perform the opening theme song "Eikyōryoku∞Idol" (Infinitely Influential Idol), and the group Rokudenashi performs the ending theme song "Hoshi o Muguru" (Traversing the Stars).

title: Game Developer enish Announces Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Frontier Zero Game for Release in 2027
content:
Game developer enish announced on Thursday a new game based on the anime of Fujino Ōmori 's Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? ( Dungeon ni Deai o Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darō ka ) light novel series titled Dungeon ni Deai o Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darō ka Familia Myth : Frontier Zero , which will launch for iOS, Android, and PC next year. The game will feature a new and original story with cooperation by Ōmori, and is also planned for international release.

Ōmori's original Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? light novel series currently has 21 volumes, and its spinoff series Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? On the Side: Sword Oratoria has 16 volumes. The franchise has over 20 million copies in circulation.

Dungeon ni Deai o Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darō ka V: Hōjō no Megami-hen ( Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? V : Goddess of the Harvest Arc), the fifth and latest anime season , premiered in October 2024. HIDIVE streamed the series in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

After a delay, HIDIVE began streaming the fifth season's 12th and 13th episodes on February 7, 2025, and the 14th episode on February 26, 2025. It streamed the 15th episode on March 5, 2025.

The anime will have a sixth season.

Team Caravan launched the Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? : Battle Chronicle ( Dungeon ni Deai o Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darō ka Battle Chronicle ) battle action role-playing game for PC, iOS and Android devices in August 2023 after a delay . The game was originally slated to launch in 80 countries simultaneously including Japan in May 2023. The game launched for PS4 and PS5 in February 2024. The game ended all its service in September 2025.

Bushiroad released the Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? : Fulland of Water and Light ( Dungeon ni Deai o Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darō ka : Mizu to Hikaru no Fulland ) action role-playing game in March 2025 for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam . The game has a release in Japanese and English.

title: Aobuta Film Opens at #4, New Live-Action Street Fighter Film at #8 in Japan
content:
The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise stayed at #2 in its second weekend. The film sold 189,000 tickets and earned 330,965,650 yen (about US$2.10 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 800,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 1,373,385,400 yen (about US$8.75 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9 and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets and earned 626,567,150 yen (about US$3.97 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film.

The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel rose from #4 to #3 in its second weekend. The film sold 174,000 tickets and earned 263,008,500 yen (about US$1.67 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 640,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 948,311,200 yen (about US$6.04 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 234,000 tickets and earned 350,531,400 yen (about US$2.23 million) in its first three days.

The film stars Ryūsei Yokohama ( Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's Kazuaki Ōmae) as Kai Aono and Suzu Hirose (live-action Chihayafuru films' Chihaya, The Boy and The Beast 's Kaede) as Akimi Inoue. Michihito Fujii (live-action Last Samurai Standing ) directed the film off a screenplay by Naoko Adachi (live-action Daytime Shooting Star , Un chocolatier de l'amour perdu ).

The novel's story begins on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Akimi, who lives on the island, meets Kai, who just moved to the island. Both bond over their misgivings about their own families and life. Akimi's home life is strained by her father constantly cheating, while Kai's mother constantly makes both of them move to be with a new relationship. The two get into a complicated, supporting, and co-dependent relationship over the course of 15 years.

Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ( Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ), the latest anime of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream ( Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film earned 186,464,420 yen (about US$1.18 million) in its first three days.

The new film takes the story towards its finale. (The film shares the same name as the 15th and final novel volume.)

The film opened in theaters in Japan on October 16.

Sōichi Masui returned to direct the film at CloverWorks . Masahiro Yokotani is also back to oversee and write the script, and Satomi Tamura again designed the characters. The band fox capture plan also returned to compose the music. Aniplex is once again distributing the film.

Tōko Kirishima performs the song "Turn the World Upside Down" in the film and the theme song "Suihei-sen wa Boku no Furukizu finale" (The Horizon Is My Old Wound: Finale).

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #1 to #7 in its 13th weekend in Japan's box office. The film sold earned 121,317,100 yen (about US$772,900) from Friday to Sunday.

The film has sold a total of 12.42 million tickets, and earned a cumulative total of 18,153,074,500 yen (about US$115 million). The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 12th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series ranked opened at #8 in Japan. The film earned 134,019,900 yen (about US$853,900) in its first three days.

The film opened on October 16. The film ranked at #1 in the U.S. box office in its opening weekend with an estimated US$31 million. It also earned an estimated US$20.1 million in 65 markets outside of the U.S., for an estimated US$51.1 million opening weekend globally. The film's IMAX screenings earned US$7.7 million globally, with US$5.4 million of that earned in the U.S., and US$2.3 million from overseas markets.

Paramount Pictures and Legendary signed a multi-year distribution deal in December, with Paramount Pictures distributing Legendary Entertainment films worldwide except China (Legendary East handles distribution in China). Street Fighter is the first film to be distributed under the new deal. Legendary Entertainment acquired the film and television rights to Street Fighter in April 2023, and will work with CAPCOM on future projects.

The Girls und Panzer das Finale Part 5 film did not rank in the top 10 in its second weekend, but it still earned 82,371,400 yen (about US$524,000) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a total of 450,004,900 yen (about US$2. 86 million).
author: ANN

contentBlocks.text: The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise stayed at #2 in its second weekend. The film sold 189,000 tickets and earned 330,965,650 yen (about US$2.10 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 800,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 1,373,385,400 yen (about US$8.75 million).
The film opened in Japan on October 9 and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets and earned 626,567,150 yen (about US$3.97 million) in its first three days.
The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).
Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film.

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku live-action film's X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel rose from #4 to #3 in its second weekend. The film sold 174,000 tickets and earned 263,008,500 yen (about US$1.67 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 640,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 948,311,200 yen (about US$6.04 million).
The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 234,000 tickets and earned 350,531,400 yen (about US$2.23 million) in its first three days.

The film stars Ryūsei Yokohama ( Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's Kazuaki Ōmae) as Kai Aono and Suzu Hirose (live-action Chihayafuru films' Chihaya, The Boy and The Beast 's Kaede) as Akimi Inoue. Michihito Fujii (live-action Last Samurai Standing ) directed the film off a screenplay by Naoko Adachi (live-action Daytime Shooting Star , Un chocolatier de l'amour perdu ).

The novel's story begins on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Akimi, who lives on the island, meets Kai, who just moved to the island. Both bond over their misgivings about their own families and life. Akimi's home life is strained by her father constantly cheating, while Kai's mother constantly makes both of them move to be with a new relationship. The two get into a complicated, supporting, and co-dependent relationship over the course of 15 years.

contentBlocks.credit: Image courtesy of Aniplex

contentBlocks.text: Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ( Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ), the latest anime of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream ( Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film earned 186,464,420 yen (about US$1.18 million) in its first three days.
The new film takes the story towards its finale. (The film shares the same name as the 15th and final novel volume.)
The film opened in theaters in Japan on October 16.

Sōichi Masui returned to direct the film at CloverWorks . Masahiro Yokotani is also back to oversee and write the script, and Satomi Tamura again designed the characters. The band fox capture plan also returned to compose the music. Aniplex is once again distributing the film.
Tōko Kirishima performs the song "Turn the World Upside Down" in the film and the theme song "Suihei-sen wa Boku no Furukizu finale" (The Horizon Is My Old Wound: Finale).

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Eiga Chiikawa Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu anime film's website

contentBlocks.text: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #1 to #7 in its 13th weekend in Japan's box office. The film sold earned 121,317,100 yen (about US$772,900) from Friday to Sunday.

The film has sold a total of 12.42 million tickets, and earned a cumulative total of 18,153,074,500 yen (about US$115 million). The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 12th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.
The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.
The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Street Fighter film's X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series ranked opened at #8 in Japan. The film earned 134,019,900 yen (about US$853,900) in its first three days.

The film opened on October 16. The film ranked at #1 in the U.S. box office in its opening weekend with an estimated US$31 million. It also earned an estimated US$20.1 million in 65 markets outside of the U.S., for an estimated US$51.1 million opening weekend globally. The film's IMAX screenings earned US$7.7 million globally, with US$5.4 million of that earned in the U.S., and US$2.3 million from overseas markets.

Paramount Pictures and Legendary signed a multi-year distribution deal in December, with Paramount Pictures distributing Legendary Entertainment films worldwide except China (Legendary East handles distribution in China). Street Fighter is the first film to be distributed under the new deal. Legendary Entertainment acquired the film and television rights to Street Fighter in April 2023, and will work with CAPCOM on future projects.

The Girls und Panzer das Finale Part 5 film did not rank in the top 10 in its second weekend, but it still earned 82,371,400 yen (about US$524,000) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a total of 450,004,900 yen (about US$2. 86 million).

title: Yukari Takinami's Watashitachi wa Mutsū Renai ga Shitai Manga Gets Live-Action Net Show
content:
The wraparound jacket band on the ninth compiled book volume of Yukari Takinami 's Watashitachi wa Mutsū Renai ga Shitai: Kagi Aka Joshi to Hoshikuzu Danshi to Femi Ojisan (We Want a Painless Romance ~Private Account Woman and Stardust Man and Feminist Uncle) manga, which shipped on Thursday, revealed that it is getting a live-action net adaptation. More details will be revealed at a later date.

The manga's story centers on Minami, who can only express her true feelings through a private social media account. She is fed up with having to fulfill the traditional role of a "woman," getting bumped into by strangers on the street, and being treated roughly by "stardust men" (good looking men who are trash). Then she meets an older male "feminist uncle."

Takinami launched the manga on Kodansha 's &Sofa manga website when it opened in November 2021. Kodansha shipped the manga's first volume in 2022, and the eighth volume on February 20.

Takinami launched the Ex-Enthusiasts: Motokare Mania ( Motokare Mania ) manga in Kodansha 's Kiss magazine in June 2017, and ended it in March 2021. Kodansha published the manga's sixth and final in May 2021. Kodansha Comics licensed the manga and it published the sixth volume in English in October 2021.

The manga inspired a live-action television series adaptation in October 2019.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams English Dub for 'The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game,' The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe Films
content:
Crunchyroll has added the English dub version for The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game ( Tennis no Oujisama: Futari no Samurai The First Game ) and The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe ( Tennis no Oujisama: Atobe Kara no Okurimono ) films on October 15.

The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game — the first film in the franchise — opened in Japan in January 2005, along with the 30-minute The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe . Crunchyroll also streams the films in Japanese audio with English subtitles.

The Prince of Tennis: Two Samurais, The First Game is set on a cruise ship, where players from Seigaku participate in an exhibition game. But they discover that the event is being run by a corrupt millionaire who wants them to lose the match on purpose.

In The Prince of Tennis: A Gift from Atobe film, Hyoutei Gakuen team captain Keigo Atobe throws a big party for his friend and teammate Munehiro Kabaji, and they participated in different sports and activities.

Shin Tennis no Ōji-sama U-17 World Cup Kesshō Member Ketteisen ( The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Finals Members Decisive Match), the franchise 's latest anime and sequel to The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Semifinal ( Shin Tennis no Ōji-sama U-17 World Cup Semifinal ) anime, premiered on September 30. Crunchyroll streams the anime as it airs.

The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Semifinal debuted in October 2024. The anime centers on the Japan vs. Germany semifinal, and is itself a sequel to The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup anime series.

Takeshi Konomi serialized the original manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 1999 to 2008. The manga follows middle school tennis player Ryōma Echizen as he battles rivals to reach the national tournament. The manga inspired a 2001-2005 television anime, two anime feature films and a theatrical short, various video anime projects , a live-action film , a live-action television series in China, and a popular stage musical series.

Konomi launched The New Prince of Tennis sequel manga in Shueisha 's Jump Square magazine in 2009, and ended the series on August 4. Shueisha published the manga's 48th and final compiled book volume on September 4.

title: Seven Seas Licenses Sagrada Reset Novel; Two Cats and a Dog, The Mercenary Bomber Explodes All Cheaters Manga
content:
Seven Seas announced the following manga, light novel, and audiobook licenses on Wednesday:

These so-called heroes? Japanese high schoolers summoned en masse, granted cheat-level powers, and now plunging the world into chaos.

Reborn as Rei and partnered with the beautiful and deadly elf warrior Lydina, Suzuki must bring every skill he has to the battlefield—from modern combat tactics and classical martial arts to his newly awakened magic. But this mission is more than a bloodbath. The goddess's true motives remain shrouded, and a larger conspiracy is unfolding behind the scenes. Can Rei survive long enough to cross every name off his list—including a Sword Saint, an Arch Sage, and a deadly Necromancer?

An adorable, full-color comic about the daily life of three affectionate pets and their devoted human.

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime Reveals 4 Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced four more cast members for the anime on Thursday. The four cast members voice the royal family of the Country of Long Nights. In the "Country of Long Nights" arc which starts in episode 4, Eleonora, Insomniac, and Johanne are all going to this country for a diplomatic mission.

Naomi Shindō as Hyrokkin, queen of the Country of Long Nights

Atsushi Ono as Rollo, the prince consort of Hyrokkin

Ai Kayano as Birgitta, Hyrokkin's eldest daughter, and her heir presumptive

Yurie Funato as Kastehelmi, Birgitta's daughter and third in line to the monarchy

The fantasy romance manga centers on seven brothers who are knights of the Marronnier Kingdom. The kingdom lies in the center of a group of eight kingdoms, and each brother is dispatched to a different kingdom as ambassadors, to go on an adventure to find their fated partner.

The anime stars:

• Kengo Takanashi as Nemukunai (Insomniac)

• Makoto Tanikawa as Hakuai (Fraternity)

• Haruki Ishiya as Atsugariya (Feverish)

• Satoshi Inomata as Samugariya (Chilly)

• Kiyoto Mizuno as Kemono Tsukai (Beast-Tamer)

• Taishi Murata as Tsurugi Jiman (Swordsman)

• Reiji Kawashima as Harapeko (Hungry)

• Akeno Watanabe as Baribara

• Show Hayami as Narrator

Kiyoko Sayama ( Skip Beat! , Vampire Knight , To Your Eternity seasons 2-3) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Shinzō Fujita ( To Your Eternity seasons 1-3, The World Is Still Beautiful ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Yuriko Maeda (chief animation director for Requiem of the Rose King , One Punch Man TV 2 ) is designing the characters, Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( Apocalypse Hotel , Land of the Lustrous , Love Live! School idol project ) is composing the music, and Jin Aketagawa ( Dr. Stone , Fire Force ) is the sound director.

The anime premiered on the NHK Educational channel on October 3 at 6:25 p.m. JST (5:25 a.m. EDT). Amazon Prime Video is streaming the anime, and is also streaming an English dub .

Viz Media licensed the manga on October 1 and uploaded the first two chapters digitally on the same day.

The manga launched in Shogakukan 's Flowers magazine in 2016. Shogakukan shipped the 11th volume on June 10. The manga topped the list of manga for female readers in the 2018 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.
author: ANN
